fullPassage: It's conceivable that in a world where solar panels are incredibly expensive and there's an extreme collapse in the cost of launching objects to space, you might want to maximize your energy per panel by putting them above the atmosphere. But panels are cheap, and even if we assume pretty steep drops in the cost of space launch, the numbers don't add up. This becomes especially clear when you start to think about maintenance. Try to imagine acres upon acres of glass panels in space, regularly hit by intense radiation and bits of space debris while enduring the extreme heat of constant sunlight. They'll have to be repaired and cared for either by astronauts or an army of advanced robots. Solar panels in Australia can be cleaned by a teenager with a spray bottle and a cloth.

questions.passage: It's conceivable that in a world where solar panels are incredibly expensive and there's an extreme collapse in the cost of launching objects to space, you might want to maximize your energy per panel by putting them above the atmosphere. But panels are cheap, and even if we assume pretty steep drops in the cost of space launch, the numbers don't add up. This becomes especially clear when you start to think about maintenance. Try to imagine acres upon acres of glass panels in space, regularly hit by intense radiation and bits of space debris while enduring the extreme heat of constant sunlight. They'll have to be repaired and cared for either by astronauts or __________. Solar panels in Australia can be cleaned by a teenager with a spray bottle and a cloth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우주 패널은 우주비행사나 '첨단 로봇 군대'에 의해 수리되고 관리되어야 한다.
det.analysis:

❌ ② acres upon acres of glass panels — 수 에이커의 유리 패널 (수리 주체가 아님)
✅ ③ an army of advanced robots — 첨단 로봇 군대. 우주비행사와 병렬로 수리/관리 주체 ←정답
❌ ④ the cost of space launch — 우주 발사 비용 (수리 주체가 아님)
